candidates.text:
The one person marketing team has never been more possible with AI. 

I had the pleasure of working with the @pactfinance team over a 30 day sprint. Their product and BD team is cracked. Underrated company. They just officially announced their partnership with Payactiv, which powers payroll for 50M+ americans and are using PACT's stablecoin rails for even more capital efficiency and early pay. Their Series A is by Tether. This is direct, existing distribution. 

I helped them refine brand, redid their largest recent announcements, created automations to surface community, partner, competitor news, and handed off the SOPs and brand guidelines. 

It used to be a frustration by crypto marketers that companies would expect them to juggle content, social, distribution, kols, at once. I believe it's table stakes today to have the know-how on operating this as a strong marketer. A designer, editor, engineer is still immensely helpful for the last mile of polish, but there's so much more a single person can do now. I am used to managing teams of social media managers, paid marketers, and content writers. I am shocked with how much more equipped I am to execute things now. This is an operator's renaissance. Never stop learning, or doing.  

You can see some of the recent content PACT team is pushing out now to compare the before and afters and see what's possible with AI. Expect to hear more of them, I'm confident in the team's experience with onchain payments, credit, and payroll -and- they have a lot coming in the works soon.
